title: Escaping the Phylogenetic Trap: Persistent Homology Enables Cross-Species Ion Channel Classification via Multimodal Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.30394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein classifiers are highly sensitive to evaluation protocol: random train/test splits induce phylogenetic leakage, allowing models to exploit taxon-specific correlations and substantially overestimate out-of-distribution performance. This issue is particularly acute for venom compound classification by ion-channel target (Ca2+, K+, Na+), where reported accuracies of 80-90% do not reflect generalization to unseen taxa. We formulate cross-species prediction as a structured distribution shift in which taxonomic identity acts as a confounder, requiring representations that capture structural features invariant across phylogeny. Using a shared multimodal backbone that fuses ESM-2 sequence embeddings with a disulfide-aware graph attention network, we systematically compare five structural inductive biases (spectral, Riemannian, SE(3)-invariant, statistical-manifold, and persistent-homology representations) under a leave-one-taxon-out evalu

translated_title: 逃离系统发育陷阱：持续同调助力多模态图神经网络实现跨物种离子通道分类
translated_abstract: 蛋白质分类器对评估协议高度敏感：随机划分训练/测试集会导致系统发育泄漏，使模型利用特定分类群的相关性，从而显著高估分布外性能。这一问题在按离子通道靶点（Ca²⁺、K⁺、Na⁺）对毒素化合物进行分类的任务中尤为突出，文献中报告的80–90%准确率并不能反映模型对未见分类群的泛化能力。我们将跨物种预测构建为一种结构化分布偏移问题，其中分类学身份充当混杂因素，因此需要能够捕捉跨系统发育不变的结构特征的表示方法。我们采用一个共享的多模态骨干网络，将ESM-2序列嵌入与二硫键感知的图注意力网络相融合，并在留一分类群评估协议下系统比较了五种结构归纳偏置（谱方法、黎曼几何、SE(3)-不变、统计流形以及持续同调表示）……
tldr: 该研究揭示随机数据划分导致的系统发育泄漏会高估毒素离子通道分类器性能，并提出融合ESM-2序列嵌入与二硫键感知图注意力网络的多模态框架，证明持续同调等结构归纳偏置能在留一分类群评估下实现真正的跨物种泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that random train/test splits cause phylogenetic leakage that inflates venom ion-channel classifier performance, and proposes a multimodal framework fusing ESM-2 embeddings with a disulfide-aware graph attention network, showing that persistent homology representations enable genuine cross-species generalization under leave-one-taxon-out evaluation.
